summary: Loma Negra filed a 6-K disclosing a board resolution approving a 30-month concrete supply agreement with related party SACDE for the Bahía Blanca granular urea plant. Because the contract exceeds 1% of corporate net worth, it is a material related-party transaction under Argentina's Capital Markets Law; the Audit Committee issued a favorable arm's-length opinion, and the board approved unanimously. No securities, price per share, or ownership terms are involved. The item is an ordinary commercial supply contract with related-party disclosure, akin to a US related-party contract Form 8-K, not a special situation; no arbitrage angle.
